Ratio Launcher: Productivity Homescreen – Personalize Your Phone and Customize Home Screen!

Your phone organizer is a tool, and with Ratio Launcher: Productivity Homescreen, you have the option to use it efficiently. This customizer & minimalist launcher aims at reducing distractions so that you can achieve your goals with ease. Your phone will transform into a highly productive phone organizer. Ratio Launcher: Productivity Homescreen gives you the power to stay in control at all times. Your phone customizer will no longer be a distraction, but a productivity tool! 📄Key Features of Ratio Launcher: Productivity Homescreen:📄 📱 Smart phone organizer – Get instant access to grouped apps. 📱 Minimalist design – Clean and distraction free customize home screen app. 📱 Universal search – Search for apps, contacts, and other information all in one place. 📱 Time tracker – Increase productivity by controlling app usage. 📱 App Lock & App Hider – Hide your apps and keep them private. 📱 Custom widgets – Weather, notes, media player, integrated calendar, and many more. 📱 Dark mode, Light mode & Focus mode – Customize the interface according to your needs.

A smartphone productivity tool as an easy home screen customizer & minimalist launcher!

Easy Home Screen Customizer & Minimalist Launcher is not simply a home screen customizer & minimalist launcher but a powerful productivity tool. Effortless Organization with Smart Drawers:📂 With Phone Customizer, your apps can be stored in drawers which are set in pace with your lifestyle. Either allow the System to auto- sort apps into Creativity, Finance, and so on, or manually adjust them to your liking in this phone organizer. Put your most-used apps on the screen while cutting down clutter. Privacy and Control with App Lock & App Hider:🔒 Ratio Launcher: Productivity Homescreen is all about making sure your pri­vacy comes first. Lock off some sensitive apps to hide unnecessary ones and enjoy a distraction-free and easy home screen customizer. You can clean up your source of distraction, which will allow you to stay at work and, at the same time, take control of your device security with this phone organizer. Custom Widgets for Productivity:📆 Ratio Launcher: Productivity Homescreen combines essential widgets Calendar, Weather, Notes, and Media Player for streamlined daily tasks to be done with utmost productivity.
